survey.title: Oncologist Decision-Making in First-Line Metastatic NSCLC Immunotherapy

sourceAnchor.quote: Which of the following immunotherapies for metastatic non-small cell lung cancer are you aware of?

obligations.requirement: Q1. Which of the following immunotherapies for metastatic non-small cell lung cancer are you aware of?
expectedObservables: Question Q1 is displayed with text: "Which of the following immunotherapies for metastatic non-small cell lung cancer are you aware of?"
Answer input is of type checkbox
Option 1: "KEYTRUDA"
Option 2: "OPDIVO"
Option 3: "TECENTRIQ"
Option 4: "IMFINZI"
Option 5: "LIBTAYO"
Option 99: "None of the above"
